reliability: Public vendor page read directly with curl; HTTP 200. Primary evidence of advertised scope only, not independently tested functionality or customer demand.
findings: LCPtracker describes a cloud-based single-contractor application for self-performing contractors not managing other subcontractors' compliance.
The vendor says users upload payroll data to generate certified payroll reports; it describes built-in validations and mathematical checks.
The vendor lists XML output for California DIR, Washington Labor & Industries and Maryland Department of Labor.
limitations: The broad payroll-compatibility statement does not specify every supported source field, version, upload schema or exception path.
Vendor-hosted testimonials are curated; none is counted as independent proof of unmet pain.
No independent small-contractor time/cost measurement, failure rate or willingness-to-pay evidence.
title: LCPcertified | Certified Payroll Software for Subs
